ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity values; the visible fluke surface is approximately 95% dark pigmentation with high-intensity pixels restricted to localized scarring and the whitewater at the fluke base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular nodes (mottling/scars) are visible in the lower-central region and concentrated as high-density clusters at the lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an acute convergence angle approximately 40-45 degrees relative to the lobe midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography; the right lobe exhibits prominent, high-amplitude serrations (peaks) while the left lobe shows a mix of low-amplitude waves and sharp indentations near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch extending to the lateral tips, with a sharp dorsal-orientated curve at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters on the distal lateral edges of both lobes, consistent with sessile barnacle colonization. Isolated circular white scars are present on the mid-ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, fine linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the dark surface of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the outer margins and trailing edges of the tips; significant linear rake marks across the majority of the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The outer lateral margins exhibit a highly jagged, high-contrast white-and-black pixel boundary due to the density of parasitic colonization.
